articles.title: Jota 'met some demons' during long injury absence
articles.summary: Jota admits he "met some demons" during his long injury absence but believes there is no need to "rush" his return to full match fitness at Celtic.

articles.title: UEFA demands answers from FIFA over Infantino dealings in urgent letter
articles.summary: UEFA is increasing the pressure on Gianni Infantino and has sent FIFA an urgent letter demanding answers to 42 detailed questions about his presidency.
